source_findings: The repaired physical-liveness path can produce ten simultaneous NODE_RESULT packets from one exact snapshot.
The current exact-current per-packet admission rule requires each packet epoch/digest to equal current S1.
Each successful coordinator_commit advances global S1 epoch.
Therefore after admitting one untouched packet from a same-snapshot cohort, the remaining untouched cohort packets become stale under the current rule.
Using a later sequential process cohort to obtain fresh packets proves a different property and splices physical-concurrency evidence from one cohort to admission evidence from another.

why: It preserves exact observation provenance without silently rewriting old NODE_RESULT epoch/digest fields.
It allows the exact ten simultaneously live process packets to be the exact evidence set consumed by the coordinator path.
It changes S1 once for one bounded cohort instead of forcing N mutually incompatible exact-current per-packet commits.
It keeps arbitration, lease validation, batch ordering, deduplication and CAS in deterministic fabric code rather than teaching a model a second authority system.
decision.counterhypothesis: If product acceptance only intends two separately named component properties—physical concurrent liveness and sequential fresh-result admission—same-cohort fan-in is unnecessary. In that case the current split proof should be explicitly narrowed and must not be called an integrated physical GRID10 result path.

base_acceptance_scope.name: PHYSICAL_GRID10_SINGLE_SCOPE_ATOMIC_COHORT_BASE
base_acceptance_scope.reason_for_single_scope_base: A single scope isolates the physical same-cohort fan-in invariant. Multi-scope/multi-coordinator semantics are a later independent gate and must not be smuggled into base acceptance through global-epoch ambiguity.

required_order: 1. Seed deterministic S1 fixture and runtime membership.
2. Elect one valid temporary coordinator for GLOBAL before ordinary cohort observation; lease creation is therefore already part of the cohort snapshot identity.
3. Start ten independent ordinary Xeno OS processes with distinct runtime membership/process identities.
4. Freeze S1 writers for the bounded cohort-read interval and require all ten children to hold explicit read transactions against one identical generation+epoch+digest snapshot.

5. Each child emits one immutable NODE_RESULT/v1 plus producer/read attestation bound to node membership identity, OS process identity, consumed snapshot identity, consumed task/read-set identity and payload digest.
6. Parent verifies all ten processes were simultaneously live at one barrier and binds each exact packet_digest to the corresponding live process identity before release.

7. After collecting the exact same ten packets, but before any S1 mutation, deterministic fabric validates the complete cohort as one set against the same expected starting snapshot and the already-present valid GLOBAL coordinator lease.
8. Deterministic coordinator integration derives one cohort summary candidate from exactly the ten admitted packet digests in deterministic order.

9. One atomic S1 transaction commits the cohort result: validate expected start epoch/digest again, insert all ten result identities under one cohort/batch identity, update the GLOBAL S1 summary once, and advance global epoch exactly once.
10. Original NODE_RESULT observation epoch/digest values remain immutable historical provenance. Only the derived cohort summary receives the new post-commit S1 epoch.
11. Replay of the same cohort/batch identity is idempotent or rejected without a second S1 state transition.

candidate_atomic_commit_semantics.precondition: current S1 generation+epoch+digest exactly equals the cohort starting identity and the referenced GLOBAL coordinator lease is still valid and bound to that starting snapshot/generation policy
transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE or equivalent single deterministic write transaction
recheck current starting identity inside transaction
recheck cohort_id and every packet/read/process binding
recheck packet set size=10 and uniqueness
compute deterministic summary candidate from immutable packet set
write one GLOBAL summary candidate with provenance containing cohort_id and exact packet digests
record all ten result identities as members of the same cohort admission
candidate_atomic_commit_semantics.postcondition: one bounded S1 candidate-state transition attributable to the exact ten-process cohort; no S0 truth and no real-effect authority

later_independent_gates: coordinator crash/replacement during active cohort formation
ordinary node restart/rejoin with new process identity
GWT broadcast uptake and causal re-entry

evaluation_concepts_to_add_or_strengthen: immutable observation provenance vs current derived summary
atomic fan-in vs sequential exact-current admission
stale observation must not be relabeled current
component evidence scope vs whole-product credit
trigger2_training_eval_reinjection.model_side_target: Given typed deterministic outcomes, preserve evidence age/provenance, request recomputation when batch preconditions fail, and reason over the current coordinator summary without claiming that old NODE_RESULT observations themselves became current.

next_exact_action: Implement one test-only deterministic successor that realizes this single-scope atomic cohort contract using the exact ten packets from the simultaneous barrier cohort, with disjoint-cohort, packet-tamper, stale-before-batch and replay negatives. Do not create a new runtime execution pin until that source is current, self-falsifying, deduplicated against parallel work and re-reviewed under current owner/supervisor authority.
